decision: Keep explicitly selectable integration-tested development composition; do not promote reactive generation because strict external-review calibration failed.

selections.decay: implemented, not selected because forecast gains did not establish intervention utility
selections.planner: analytic-only for this explicit experimental integration
selections.assessment: Keep source-bound-model-assessment-v2 in explicit development configuration:32/32 exposed cases, no claim of generalization or measured mastery
selections.reactive_generation: V19, integration-tested with injected provider; V18 live results are not V19 semantic qualification
selections.proactive_wording: existing bounded strategy and literal source rendering, not V19 free generation
selections.external_review: Completed Nano/Mini common review, strict calibration failed; diagnostics only. No product-model substitution.

fallback.configuration: Unset APP_EXPERIMENTAL_TUTORING_CANDIDATE and all APP_POST_REPORT_* settings; restart API and worker together. Do not mix worker/API profiles.
fallback.autonomy_stop: Use existing professor pause/kill-switch or student opt-out; do not bypass source or consent checks.

spending_policy: The V19 experiment declares a Sol revision role. No additional paid runs of that role are scheduled. Inexpensive external judges do not change this product configuration.
selection_scope: A development configuration record, not a SystemReleaseProfile, deployment action, or claim that all candidates are better.
